null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero
scope: UMass Amherst, not other UMass campuses

tool.name: Vanguard Renewables / Barstow's Farm anaerobic digestion
tool.ecosystem_role: Downstream processing of collected food scraps

current_use_evidence.coverage: Collected pre- and post-consumer food waste from dining commons, Campus Center and retail locations

tool.assumption_for_the_build: Keep as downstream context, outside the core food-production optimizer. Distinguish landfill diversion from source reduction.
limitations: Diverted food has already entered a waste stream.
More diverted tonnage can reflect better capture or greater activity; it does not by itself establish less food waste.
Tonnage does not identify avoidable edible waste separately from unavoidable scraps.
Generic composting descriptions are historical or may describe other streams; current Dining sources identify anaerobic digestion.
